fixes.en: Commencing the operation to wipe out the U.N.'s foe: the "Anti-U.N. Forces."\nAnnihilate the Anti-U.N. TYPE-29 fighter formation.
fixes.why: refit: "U.N. Forces" to "U.N.'s", "enemy" to "foe"; L2 drops repeated "Forces'"

fixes.en: Commencing the operation to wipe out the U.N.'s foe: the "Anti-U.N. Forces."\nAnnihilate the Anti-U.N. TYPE-29 fighter formation.

fixes.en: The "VF-0": a variable fighter developed with the ASS-1's OverTechnology.\nTo survive the battles ahead, you'll now undergo VF-0 conversion training.
fixes.why: refit: tighter wording

fixes.en: The Anti-U.N. Forces made a surprise attack with VFs built using our tech.\nSortie at once and annihilate the Anti-U.N. variable fighters.
fixes.why: refit: "variable fighters" abbreviated to "VFs" in L1, "technology" to "tech"; second Anti-U.N. mention shortened

fixes.en: To prepare for the escalating Anti-U.N. war, we'll hold a mock battle drill.\nWin the mock battle against U.N. Forces ace Major Roy Focker.
fixes.why: refit: "mock battle as training" to "mock battle drill"; L2 aligned with row 265 (same source line)

fixes.en: The Anti-U.N. Forces are trying to seize the AFOS fragment on Mayan Island.\nExpect unfamiliar underwater combat, but wipe out the Anti-U.N. at all costs.
fixes.why: refit: tighter wording, second mention "Anti-U.N."

fixes.en: The Anti-U.N. Forces attack the Asuka to seize the AFOS fragment under study.\nDefend the carrier Asuka and annihilate the Anti-U.N. at all costs.
fixes.why: refit: restructured so the Asuka is named as the target in L1; second mention "Anti-U.N."

fixes.en: The Anti-U.N. Forces attack the Asuka to seize the AFOS fragment under study.\nDefend the carrier Asuka and annihilate the Anti-U.N. at all costs.
fixes.why: refit: restructured so the Asuka is named as the target in L1; second mention "Anti-U.N."

fixes.en: The Bird Human's head: another AFOS fragment, newly found on Mayan Island.\nFind it before the Anti-U.N. Forces do and bring it to the target area.
fixes.why: refit: L2 refers to the head as "it" (named in L1)

fixes.en: We lost the Bird Human's head in a fierce battle with the Anti-U.N. Forces.\nWe can't let them recover it. Wipe out the Anti-U.N. Forces searching for it.
fixes.why: refit: "lost track of ... after" to "lost ... in"

fixes.en: Both the U.N. Forces and the Anti-U.N. Forces now hold AFOS fragments.\nWipe out the Anti-U.N. to claim the AFOS fragments for our U.N. Forces.
fixes.why: refit: second mention "Anti-U.N."

fixes.en: Both the U.N. Forces and the Anti-U.N. Forces now hold AFOS fragments.\nWipe out the Anti-U.N. to claim the AFOS fragments for our U.N. Forces.

fixes.why: refit: second mention "Anti-U.N."

fixes.en: To seize the AFOS fragment being studied by the U.N. Forces, we will now\nraid the carrier Asuka. Wipe out the U.N. escorts and seize the AFOS fragment.
fixes.why: refit: "escorting U.N. units" to "U.N. escorts"

fixes.en: Both the U.N. Forces and the Anti-U.N. Forces now hold AFOS fragments.\nWipe out the U.N. to claim the AFOS fragments for our Anti-U.N. Forces.
fixes.why: refit: second mention "U.N."

fixes.en: During its launch ceremony, the Macross fired its main gun at an unknown fleet.\nBattle with the aliens looks unavoidable. Get into intercept position at once.
fixes.why: refit: "unidentified space fleet" to "unknown fleet"

fixes.en: During its launch ceremony, the Macross fired its main gun at an unknown fleet.\nBattle with the aliens looks unavoidable. Get into intercept position at once.
fixes.why: refit: "unidentified space fleet" to "unknown fleet"

fixes.en: To escape the giant aliens' attack, the Macross now attempts a space launch.\nEscort the blundering VF-1D while wiping out the giant alien ground forces.
fixes.why: refit: "blundering around the battlefield" to "blundering"

fixes.en: Beginning the Transformation to fire the main gun at the giant alien fleet.\nDefend the Macross at all costs while the Transformation is under way.
fixes.why: refit: L1 restructured; L2 unchanged

fixes.en: Our rookies lack experience, so we'll now hold a mock battle as training.\nWin the mock battle against U.N. Forces ace Major Roy Focker.
fixes.why: refit: L1 restructured; L2 aligned with row 233 (same source line)

fixes.en: To break out of this defensive fight, we'll surprise-attack the giant aliens.\nDefend the Macross until its main gun fires.
fixes.why: refit: "purely defensive" to "defensive", "launch a surprise attack on" to "surprise-attack"

fixes.en: To break out of this defensive fight, we'll surprise-attack the giant aliens.\nDefend the Macross until its main gun fires.
fixes.why: refit: "purely defensive" to "defensive", "launch a surprise attack on" to "surprise-attack"

fixes.en: With supplies drained by repeated battles, we'll restock at Sara Base on Mars.\nRecover the supply containers. If enemies appear, switch to wiping them out.
fixes.why: refit: restructured both lines

fixes.en: Enemy units spotted approaching the Macross. A scramble has been ordered.\nMiss Macross may be on your mind, but go at once and wipe out the enemy.
fixes.why: refit: tighter wording

fixes.en: Just short of Earth, the giant aliens have demanded the Macross surrender.\nWe'll recon to learn their aims. Escort the Cat's Eye and wipe out the enemy.
fixes.why: refit: "the enemy's true intent" to "their aims"

fixes.en: Just short of Earth, the giant aliens have demanded the Macross surrender.\nWe'll recon to learn their aims. Escort the Cat's Eye and wipe out the enemy.
fixes.why: refit: "the enemy's true intent" to "their aims"

fixes.en: We've rescued Lt. Hayase and the others held captive on a Zentradi battleship,\nbut we haven't escaped the enemy ship yet. Get out of it at all costs.
fixes.why: refit: "Lieutenant" to "Lt.", second "enemy ship" to "it"

fixes.en: The Zentradi have surrounded the Macross to stop it from returning to Earth.\nIt's a hard-line move, but destroy the Zentradi to break their encirclement.
fixes.why: refit: "Zentradi forces" to "Zentradi", tighter wording

fixes.en: The Zentradi have attacked the Macross, back on Earth after a year away.\nWipe out the Zentradi forces trying to smoke the Macross out into space.
fixes.why: refit: "for the first time in a year" to "after a year away"; L2 unchanged

fixes.en: A Zentradi battleship is closing fast on the Macross as it resupplies at sea.\nWe can't let the Macross's resupply be interrupted. Wipe out the Zentradi.
fixes.why: refit: tighter wording, "Zentradi forces" to "Zentradi"

fixes.en: A Zentradi battleship is closing fast on the Macross as it resupplies at sea.\nWe can't let the Macross's resupply be interrupted. Wipe out the Zentradi.
fixes.why: refit: tighter wording, "Zentradi forces" to "Zentradi"

fixes.en: A Zentradi battleship is closing fast on the Macross as it resupplies at sea.\nWe can't let the Macross's resupply be interrupted. Wipe out the Zentradi.

fixes.en: The Ontario Autonomous Zone has agreed to take in the Macross's civilians, but\nthe Zentradi have appeared. Wipe them out so the civilians can be taken in.
fixes.why: refit: restructured (Zone as subject), second Zentradi mention as "them"

fixes.en: You'll now escort the liaison shuttle taking Capt. Hayase to U.N. HQ on Earth.\nEscort it until it reaches a safe zone, then switch to wiping out the enemy.
fixes.why: refit: "Captain" to "Capt.", "U.N. Forces HQ" to "U.N. HQ", second "shuttle" to "it"

fixes.en: At humanity's first interstellar wedding, the Zentradi hit the Macross all-out.\nWe've taken our first step to peace and can't stop here. Wipe out the enemy.
fixes.why: refit: "launched an all-out attack on" to "hit ... all-out"

fixes.en: Fearing the power of Earth's culture, Boddole Zer attacks the Macross all-out.\nWe'll use the Minmay Attack to overturn hopeless odds. Destroy Boddole Zer.
fixes.why: refit: "Golg Boddole Zer" to "Boddole Zer", "hopeless gap in strength" to "hopeless odds"

fixes.en: Fearing the power of Earth's culture, Boddole Zer attacks the Macross all-out.\nWe'll use the Minmay Attack to overturn hopeless odds. Destroy Boddole Zer.
fixes.why: refit: "Golg Boddole Zer" to "Boddole Zer", "hopeless gap in strength" to "hopeless odds"

fixes.en: Zentradi who can't fit in on Earth stole arms and are attacking civilian areas.\nWe cannot let civilians come to harm. Put down the rampaging Zentradi.
fixes.why: refit: "civilian residential areas" to "civilian areas", "weapons" to "arms"; L2 unchanged

fixes.en: To build up our forces, we'll capture the Zentradi automated spaceship factory.\nWipe out the Zentradi forces defending the factory and take the factory.
fixes.why: refit: "carry out an operation to capture" to "capture"; L2 unchanged

fixes.en: To build up our forces, we'll capture the Zentradi automated spaceship factory.\nWipe out the Zentradi forces defending the factory and take the factory.
fixes.why: refit: "carry out an operation to capture" to "capture"; L2 unchanged

fixes.en: Quamzin, who won't coexist with Earthlings, is raiding the factory to steal\nthe micronization device. We can't allow that. Wipe out Quamzin's faction.
fixes.why: refit: line break moved inside sentence 1; "cannot let them take the device" to "can't allow that"

fixes.en: Quamzin has taken civilians hostage and is demanding a battleship as ransom.\nRescuing the hostages safely comes first. Wipe out Quamzin's faction.
fixes.why: refit: L2 restructured; L1 unchanged

fixes.en: Quamzin's faction is raiding the industrial zone to steal the reaction engine.\nWipe them out to protect the reaction engine in the industrial complex block.
fixes.why: refit: "district" to "zone", second faction mention as "them"

fixes.en: Out to destroy the Macross, Quamzin's faction has suddenly hit Macross City.\nWipe them out at once to protect the Macross and the people of Macross City.
fixes.why: refit: "appeared in" to "hit", second faction mention as "them"

fixes.en: Out to destroy the Macross, Quamzin's faction has suddenly hit Macross City.\nWipe them out at once to protect the Macross and the people of Macross City.
fixes.why: refit: "appeared in" to "hit", second faction mention as "them"

fixes.en: As special training, we will now hold a mock battle using melee attacks only.\nFleet Commander Vrlitwhai himself joins this mock battle. Defeat Vrlitwhai.
fixes.why: refit: L2 tighter; L1 unchanged

fixes.en: We captured Micronians, but enemy mobile weapons have broken into the ship.\nTo stop them retaking the captives, annihilate the Micronian intruders.
fixes.why: refit: tighter wording

fixes.en: Ignoring the order to halt attacks on Micronians, Quamzin attacked their ship.\nWe can't let Quamzin get ahead of us. We're launching our own attack too.
fixes.why: refit: tighter wording

fixes.en: Fleet Cmdr. Vrlitwhai, contaminated by Culture, made his own Micronian truce.\nWe cannot allow Culture to contaminate anyone else. Erase the Micronians.
fixes.why: refit: "Commander" to "Cmdr.", "agreed to a ceasefire ... on his own authority" to "made his own ... truce"; L2 unchanged

fixes.en: As the Macross heads home from beyond the solar system, the Zentradi appear.\nFirst break their formation with reaction weapons, then annihilate them.
fixes.why: refit: restructured; "home to Earth" to "home", "preemptive strike" to "First ..."

fixes.en: We've spotted a pilot flying a Valkyrie around Saturn without permission.\nUnauthorized use of a Valkyrie won't be tolerated. Capture the pilot at once.
fixes.why: refit: "took a Valkyrie out without permission and is flying it" merged

fixes.en: The Zentradi have taken Macross crew members captive. To rescue the hostages,\ninfiltrate the enemy ship and go at once to where they're thought to be held.
fixes.why: refit: tighter wording

fixes.en: To prepare for relentless Zentradi raids, we'll now conduct special training.\nWin a mock battle against the rumored genius pilot, Maximilian Jenius.
fixes.why: refit: "the genius pilot everyone is talking about" to "the rumored genius pilot"
